description: P34: a battle as one boss on a walled 120 x 90 m bailey (z -45 to 45) with its gate to the south - the BattleBoss of battle.iron_regiment over three encounters: the wall (a shield formation of eight and its banner), the charge (a cavalry pair) and the last stand (Corvane and four iron guards in a shield formation). The encounters wait for test.bailey.manual (never set): the BattleBoss activates them phase by phase.
